title: Business Development Manager (BDM)
description:
Business Development Manager – B2B Sales & Client Acquisition

**Company:** Universal PSR Compliance LLP  
**Job Location:** D-49, Sector 6, Noida, Uttar Pradesh  
**Experience Required:** 4–6 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Department:** Business Development / Sales  
**Pay:** Up to ₹6,00,000 per year

Job Summary

Universal PSR Compliance LLP is looking for an experienced, target-oriented, and result-driven Business Development Manager to lead business development activities, drive revenue growth, and expand our client base.

The selected candidate will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, converting qualified leads into clients, developing B2B relationships, managing the sales team, achieving revenue targets, and building long-term client relationships.

Candidates with prior experience in regulatory compliance, company registration, licensing, BIS certification, EPR, FSSAI, pharmaceutical licensing, or other professional service businesses will be strongly preferred.

Key Responsibilities1. Business Development and Client Acquisition

* Identify and develop new business opportunities through various channels.
* Generate business through inbound leads, outbound calling, references, networking, and corporate tie-ups.
* Convert potential business enquiries into paying clients.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing clients.
* Understand client requirements and recommend suitable compliance and regulatory services.
* Prepare commercial proposals, quotations, and service agreements.
* Negotiate pricing and close business deals.
* Develop strategies to increase revenue and improve customer acquisition.
* Explore new markets, industries, and business segments.

2. B2B Sales and Revenue Generation

* Drive B2B sales for regulatory compliance, licensing, registration, and certification services.
* Manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation to deal closure.
* Identify high-value clients, corporate accounts, manufacturers, importers, exporters, and businesses requiring regulatory approvals.
* Develop strategies for increasing average deal value and repeat business.
* Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and achieve monthly and quarterly revenue targets.
* Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities across the company's service portfolio.
* Ensure timely follow-ups and improve lead-to-client conversion rates.

3. Team Management and Sales Operations

* Lead, manage, and motivate the Business Development Executive (BDE) and sales team.
* Assign individual targets and monitor daily, weekly, and monthly performance.
* Develop sales strategies, processes, and standard operating procedures.
* Conduct regular sales meetings and performance reviews.
* Train team members on services, sales techniques, objection handling, and client communication.
* Monitor team productivity, conversion ratios, and revenue generation.
* Implement effective lead allocation and follow-up mechanisms.
* Ensure proper coordination between the sales, operations, and marketing departments.

4. Client Relationship Management

* Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing and prospective clients.
* Understand client business requirements and provide appropriate service recommendations.
* Ensure professional communication and timely follow-ups.
* Coordinate with the execution team to ensure smooth service delivery.
* Handle escalated client concerns and support resolution of service-related issues.
* Develop strategies for repeat business, referrals, and client retention.
* Maintain client satisfaction and improve the overall customer experience.

5. Sales Strategy and Market Development

* Develop and implement monthly and quarterly business development plans.
* Conduct competitor analysis, market research, and industry mapping.
* Identify new business opportunities in manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, food, electronics, import-export, and other regulated industries.
* Develop corporate partnerships and referral networks.
* Explore opportunities for strategic alliances and channel partnerships.
* Identify new services and markets that can contribute to company revenue growth.
* Work with the marketing team to improve lead quality and campaign effectiveness.

6. CRM, Reporting and Performance Monitoring

* Maintain accurate records of leads, prospects, follow-ups, quotations, and sales closures.
* Ensure proper CRM usage and sales pipeline management.
* Track lead conversion rates, revenue, average ticket size, and sales productivity.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance reports.
* Analyze reasons for lost deals and develop corrective strategies.
* Monitor individual and team performance against assigned targets.
* Provide regular business development updates to management.

Business Development Portfolio – PSR Compliance Services

The candidate will be responsible for developing business and driving sales across the following services:

**Company & Business Registration**

* Private Limited Company Registration.
* LLP Registration.
* OPC and Section 8 Company Registration.
* Partnership Firm Registration.
* Startup India Registration.

**NGO & Corporate Compliance**

* NGO Registration.
* 12A and 80G Registration.
* FCRA Registration.
* Annual ROC Compliance.
* MCA-related Filings and Director KYC.

**BIS & Product Certification**

* BIS Certification – ISI Mark, CRS, and FMCS.
* Hallmark Registration.
* Product Certification and Compliance.

**Environmental & EPR Compliance**

* Plastic Waste EPR Registration.
* E-Waste EPR Registration.
* Battery Waste EPR Registration.
* Pollution NOC, CTE and CTO.

**Food & Regulatory Licensing**

* FSSAI Registration and Licensing.
* GACC Registration.
* LMPC Registration.
* Legal Metrology Compliance.

**Pharmaceutical & Medical Device Licensing**

* Retail and Wholesale Drug License.
* Medical Device Licensing – MD-42 and CDSCO-related services.
* Cosmetic Manufacturing License.
* Other pharmaceutical regulatory approvals.

Required Qualifications

* MBA in Marketing, Sales, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field will also be considered.
* Minimum 4–6 years of relevant experience in Business Development / B2B Sales.
* Proven track record of achieving sales targets and generating business revenue.
* Experience in managing and leading a sales or business development team.
* Strong understanding of B2B sales processes and client acquisition.
* Experience in lead management, negotiation, proposal preparation, and deal closure.
* Practical experience with CRM systems and sales reporting.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship management skills.
* Strong leadership, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.

Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates with prior experience in business development and B2B sales in the following industries will be strongly preferred:

* Regulatory Compliance and Licensing Consultancies.
* Company Registration and Corporate Secretarial Services.
* BIS Certification – ISI Mark, CRS and FMCS.
* EPR Registration and Environmental Compliance.
* FSSAI Licensing and Food Regulatory Services.

**Strong preference will be given to candidates who have previously worked with compliance consultancies, licensing agencies, certification firms, company registration companies, or similar B2B service providers.**

Candidates with an existing understanding of regulatory services, client requirements, commercial proposals, and compliance-related sales cycles will have an added advantage.

* Develop and implement effective business development strategies.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: B2B SALES EXECUTIVE — MOTOROLA & Hytera SOLUTIONS & CCTV

Location: Noida / Delhi NCR  
Employment: Full-time  
Reports to: Sales Manager / CEO

ABOUT THE ROLE

Vedabytes Technologies is looking for a sales executive to develop B2B opportunities for Motorola Solutions communication products and CCTV solutions. The role involves identifying prospective customers, understanding their requirements, preparing proposals and following opportunities through to order and payment.

PRODUCTS AND SOLUTIONS

* Motorola & Hytera Solutions: Professional & Commercial Radio and Broadband Solutions, including WAVE PTX
* CCTV and video surveillance: Vicon and other approved products in the company’s portfolio

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Generate and follow up on leads with enterprises, system integrators, security agencies, infrastructure companies and other relevant buyers. • Meet customers to understand their communication and surveillance requirements. • Recommend suitable products and coordinate technical inputs, demonstrations and quotations. • Prepare proposals, follow up on negotiations and help close orders. • Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and submit regular activity and forecast updates. • Coordinate with internal teams and suppliers on pricing, availability, delivery and customer support. • Follow up on purchase orders, invoicing and customer payments. • Build repeat business and develop new customer relationships.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

* 2–5 years of B2B sales experience, preferably in radio communication, telecom, CCTV, security or IT solutions. • Comfortable meeting customers and managing a sales process from first contact to payment. • Strong communication, follow-up and negotiation skills. • Able to prepare basic quotations and maintain CRM or spreadsheet records. • Willing to travel for customer meetings across Delhi NCR and nearby regions. • A diploma or degree in business, electronics, telecommunications or a related field is preferred.

MONTHLY TARGET AND INCENTIVE PLAN

Illustrative plan for a monthly fixed salary of ₹30,000:

* Monthly gross-profit target: ₹1,00,000, approximately 3.3 times the monthly salary. • Indicative monthly sales guide: ₹5,00,000, assuming an average gross margin of 20%. • Incentive is calculated on eligible gross profit collected during the month.

Monthly target achievement | Incentive on eligible gross profit Below 80% | No incentive 80% to 99% | 5% 100% to 124% | 8% 125% or above | 10%

At 100% achievement in this example, the incentive would be ₹8,000. At 125% achievement, it would be ₹12,500, assuming the same margin and collection basis.

TARGET FORMULA FOR OTHER SALARY LEVELS

Set the monthly gross-profit target at about 3.3 times the monthly fixed salary. For example:

* ₹25,000 monthly salary: approximately ₹83,000 gross-profit target. • ₹40,000 monthly salary: approximately ₹1,32,000 gross-profit target.

TARGET RULES

* Count sales after customer payment is received, excluding GST. • Calculate eligible gross profit after product cost and any approved deal-specific discounts or costs. • Agree pricing and minimum margins before quoting. Sales below the approved margin require written approval. • Review targets after the first two months. A practical ramp-up is 50% of target in month one and 75% in month two. • Set a separate, agreed target for large project or tender opportunities whose sales cycle extends beyond one month.

COMPENSATION

Fixed monthly salary: Negotiable  
Performance incentive: As described above  
Working days and travel reimbursement: As per company policy

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

title: Assistant Sales Manager - Print & Packaging, North India
description:
Imagine a world where everyone has access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. That is the tomorrow Veralto (VLTO) is creating today.  
  
Veralto is headquartered in Waltham, Mass. with 13 operating companies and 300+ locations worldwide. Our global team of 16,000 associates is committed to making an enduring positive impact on the world and is united by a powerful purpose: Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™.  
  
Veralto is a global leader in essential technology solutions with annual revenue of nearly $5 billion and a proven track record of solving some of the most complex challenges we face as a society. Our industry-leading companies and globally recognized brands are building on a long-established legacy of innovation and customer trust to create a safer, cleaner, more vibrant future.  
  
Veralto’s Water Quality companies—Aquatic Informatics, ChemTreat, Hach, McCrometer, OTT HydroMet, Sea-Bird Scientific, Trojan Technologies and XOS—help manage, treat, purify, and protect the global water supply, from municipal and industrial wastewater treatment facilities to lakes, rivers, watersheds, and oceans.  
  
Our Product Quality & Innovation companies—Esko, Linx, Pantone, Videojet, and X-Rite—help package and protect the world’s food, medicine, and essentials, tracing and authenticating billions of goods that travel the global supply chain every day.

**WHO WE ARE:**

Headquartered in Grand Rapids, Michigan, X-Rite is a global company with locations around the world. Experts in blending the art and science of color, we focus on providing complete end-to-end color management solutions for our clients in every industry where color matters.

**Job Details:**

**X-Rite’s Global Brand Strategic Accounts team** helps customers achieve consistent print and color quality across their global packaging supply chains. Our portfolio of products and professional services enables customers to establish color and print-quality specifications, measure performance, and report results across their operations.

**The Global Brand Color Program Manager** will lead the operational, technical, and project-management activities for a strategic global Brand account. The role will coordinate program deployment across regions, suppliers, printers, pre-media partners, and internal teams to ensure consistent execution, measurable performance, and continuous improvement.

**Job Title:** Assistant Sales Manager - Print & Packaging, North India

**Department:** Sales

**Reporting to:** Sales Manager

**Location:** Candidates ideally can be from Delhi/Gurgaon/Noida.

**Territory:** North India (Punjab, UP, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Rajasthan, Delhi, Chandigarh, J&K)

**Travel:** Frequent customer and channel travel across the assigned region - Field based role.

**Role Purpose:**

Drive profitable growth for X-Rite Pantone print and packaging solutions across North India by developing new customers, expanding strategic accounts, strengthening channel partners, and managing the complete sales cycle from opportunity creation through commercial closure, delivery coordination, and post-sale follow-up.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Sales Growth & Territory Development:**

* Develop and execute annual and quarterly territory plans aligned with revenue, bookings, product-mix, margin, and recurring-revenue objectives.
* Develop new business with:
  + Commercial printers
  + Packaging converters
  + Label printers
  + Brand owners
  + Premedia/prepress companies
  + Ink manufacturers
* Build a healthy sales pipeline through structured prospecting, customer visits, referrals, industry networking, seminars, exhibitions, and partner-led demand generation.
* Position appropriate solutions across color measurement, quality control, color workflow, ink formulation, pressroom automation, closed-loop systems, software, services, and subscriptions.
* Prepare value-based proposals, quotations, solution configurations, presentations, ROI justification, and commercial offers in line with approved pricing and business guidelines.
* Negotiate professionally and close orders while protecting price quality, payment terms, and commercial compliance.
* Drive territory revenue, bookings, margins, product mix and recurring revenue.
* Track competitor activity, customer investments, technology trends and pricing.
* Sell technical solutions covering:
  + Color measurement and spectrophotometers
  + Color/quality-control workflows
  + Ink formulation
  + Pressroom automation
  + Closed-loop systems
  + Software, services and subscriptions

**Account & Opportunity Management:**

* Manage the full sales cycle, including lead qualification, discovery, solution recommendation, demonstration, trial or proof of concept, commercial negotiation, order booking, and handover.
* Grow existing accounts through cross-selling, upgrades, service, software, subscription and replacement opportunities.
* Develop account plans for strategic customers and create cross-sell, upgrade, service, software, subscription, and replacement opportunities within the installed base.
* Maintain accurate opportunity stages, next actions, close dates, forecast categories, competitive information, and customer records in CRM.
* Provide regular forecasts and business updates covering pipeline health, order activity, negotiation status, pricing, risks, competition, and support required.

**Channel Management:**

* Manage and develop dealers, resellers, and solution partners across the assigned territory.
* Manage dealers, resellers and solution partners across North India.
* Create joint business plans, opportunity reviews, customer-visit plans, product training, and demand-generation activities with channel partners.
* Monitor partner performance, opportunity ownership, pricing discipline, forecast quality, customer coverage, and follow-up effectiveness.
* Identify potential channel gaps and support onboarding and development of suitable partners where required.

**Customer Engagement & Cross-functional Execution:**

* Conduct consultative discovery to understand customer process, application, quality challenges, workflow gaps, and expected business outcomes.
* Coordinate product demonstrations, application discussions, feasibility assessments, samples, and technical workshops with application, service, product, and marketing teams.
* Coordinate internally with applications, service, marketing, finance, customer service, supply chain and logistics.
* Work closely with customer service, finance, supply chain, logistics, service, and technical teams to support approvals, order processing, delivery, installation, training, and payment follow-up.
* Represent the company at exhibitions, conferences, customer seminars, and industry forums through professional presentations and demonstrations.
* Capture market intelligence on customer investments, competitor activity, technology trends, pricing, and emerging applications.

**Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor degree or diploma in Printing Technology, Packaging Technology, Engineering, Business Management, or a related discipline. A technical qualification in printing or packaging is preferred.
* Minimum 5 to 8 years of B2B sales or business-development experience in the printing, packaging, labels, converting, inks, prepress, pressroom, inspection, automation, or color-management industry.
* Demonstrated experience in direct sales, channel sales, solution selling, proposal development, negotiation, and closing capital equipment, software, service, or subscription opportunities.
* Established market knowledge and customer relationships in North India are strongly preferred.

**Required Skills & Competencies:**

* Consultative and value-based selling, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into customer outcomes and commercial value.
* Working knowledge of offset, flexographic, gravure, digital, label, and packaging-print production workflows; understanding of color measurement, color communication, process control, quality assurance, and print standardization.
* Ability to discuss spectrophotometers, densitometry, color tolerances, ink and substrate variables, proof-to-print alignment, pressroom quality control, workflow software, and automation at a practical customer level.
* Strong prospecting, account planning, pipeline management, forecasting, commercial negotiation, and deal-closing capability.
* Channel-partner management and the ability to influence results without direct authority.
* Clear written and verbal communication, presentation, demonstration, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Commercial acumen, structured problem solving, ownership, accountability, and disciplined follow-through.
* Proficiency with CRM, Microsoft Office, online presentation tools, and virtual collaboration platforms.
* Ability to work independently in a field-based role, manage priorities, and travel frequently across North India.
* Professional fluency in English and Hindi; additional North Indian language capability is an advantage.
* Experience in selling capital equipment, consumables, and solutions within the printing and packaging industry.
* Proven track record in sales to packaging customers, with strong exposure to printing, packaging, and related consumable products.

**Success Measures:**

* Achievement of territory revenue, bookings, product-mix, margin, and recurring-revenue goals.
* Quality and coverage of pipeline, forecast accuracy, conversion rate, and timely opportunity progression.
* New-customer acquisition, strategic-account growth, installed-base penetration, and customer retention.
* Channel productivity, partner engagement, joint opportunity creation, and territory coverage.
* CRM discipline, commercial compliance, on-time internal coordination, and customer satisfaction.

**Professional Attributes:**

* Customer-focused, ethical, self-driven, and comfortable taking ownership from first contact through completion.
* Collaborative and able to work effectively across sales, application, service, marketing, finance, supply chain, and channel teams.
* Curious and willing to continuously learn print, packaging, color science, software, automation, and customer applications.
* Resilient, adaptable, and capable of handling multiple opportunities and priorities in a dynamic regional market.

About X-Rite Pantone

X-Rite Pantone provides end-to-end color management solutions that help customers inspire, select, measure, formulate, communicate, and match color. This role offers the opportunity to build expertise in color science and technology while helping print and packaging customers improve consistency, quality, productivity, and workflow performance.

title: Business Process Outsourcing
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION (JD)Outsourcing Expert – BPO Process Acquisition & Business Development

**Company:** Edvirexa Technologies Pvt. Ltd.  
**Designation:** Outsourcing Expert / BPO Process Acquisition Manager  
**Department:** Business Development, Outsourcing & Strategic Partnerships  
**Industry:** EdTech | BPO | ITES | Customer Support | Business Outsourcing  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Mode:** Remote / Hybrid / On-Site (As per Company Requirements)  
**Experience:** 2–7+ Years (Relevant BPO Process Acquisition Experience Preferred)  
**Compensation:** Negotiable | Fixed Salary + Performance-Based Incentives (Based on Experience and Results)  
**Reporting To:** Founder & Top Management

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Edvirexa Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a growing organization operating in the fields of **Education Technology (EdTech), Professional Skill Development, Recruitment, Business Consulting, and Technology-Driven Services.**

As part of our strategic business expansion, we are entering the **Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) and IT-Enabled Services (ITES) industry**, with the objective of establishing domestic and international outsourcing operations.

We aim to build a reliable BPO division capable of delivering high-quality customer support, technical support, back-office operations, and other business outsourcing services.

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented **Outsourcing Expert / BPO Process Acquisition Manager** who can independently identify outsourcing opportunities, establish relationships with direct clients, negotiate commercial agreements, and successfully bring genuine BPO processes into the organization.

**This is a process acquisition and business development position, not a customer support executive role.**

The selected professional will play an important role in establishing and expanding the company's BPO division.

1. PRIMARY OBJECTIVE

The primary responsibility of the Outsourcing Expert will be to **acquire genuine domestic and international BPO processes for Edvirexa Technologies Pvt. Ltd.**

The candidate must be capable of identifying potential clients, generating outsourcing opportunities, negotiating business terms, coordinating process onboarding, and ensuring successful project acquisition.

Initially, the company is targeting outsourcing opportunities suitable for approximately **10–25 operational seats**, with the potential to expand based on business requirements.

2. KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIESA. BPO Process Acquisition

* Identify and acquire genuine domestic and international BPO outsourcing processes.
* Establish direct connections with companies seeking outsourcing partners.
* Generate qualified leads for inbound, outbound, voice, non-voice, and back-office processes.
* Identify outsourcing opportunities suitable for the company's operational capabilities.
* Acquire customer support, technical support, email support, chat support, and other relevant processes.
* Develop a sustainable pipeline of outsourcing projects and potential clients.
* Identify both short-term and long-term BPO business opportunities.
* Coordinate with clients to understand operational requirements and commercial expectations.

B. Direct Client Acquisition & Business Development

* Identify companies interested in outsourcing their customer support or business operations.
* Build professional relationships with domestic and international decision-makers.
* Connect with business owners, outsourcing managers, procurement teams, and vendor management departments.
* Generate leads through LinkedIn, professional networks, email campaigns, referrals, and industry platforms.
* Schedule business meetings with potential outsourcing clients.
* Present the company's outsourcing capabilities and proposed service models.
* Negotiate process requirements, operational expectations, and commercial terms.
* Convert qualified business opportunities into confirmed outsourcing projects.
* Develop long-term business relationships and repeat outsourcing opportunities.

C. Domestic & International BPO Expansion

* Identify outsourcing opportunities in the Indian market.
* Explore international opportunities, particularly in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and other relevant markets.
* Research international outsourcing trends and client requirements.
* Identify opportunities for offshore customer support and back-office services.
* Support the development of scalable outsourcing operations.
* Recommend suitable markets, industries, and outsourcing service categories.

D. Process Verification & Commercial Negotiation

* Verify the legitimacy of outsourcing clients and process providers.
* Evaluate the commercial feasibility and profitability of proposed processes.
* Understand pricing models, including per-seat, per-agent, hourly, per-transaction, and performance-based billing.
* Negotiate commercially viable payment terms and operational conditions.
* Coordinate discussions relating to contracts, SLAs, NDAs, and other business agreements.
* Identify potential risks, hidden charges, unrealistic commitments, and fraudulent outsourcing opportunities.
* Ensure that no outsourcing process is accepted without proper management approval and verification.

E. Process Onboarding & Operational Coordination

* Coordinate the transition of acquired processes to the company's operations team.
* Understand staffing, training, infrastructure, software, and technology requirements.
* Assist management in planning operational capacity and workforce requirements.
* Coordinate client training, knowledge transfer, and process documentation.
* Support pilot operations and process launch activities.
* Maintain communication between clients and internal operational teams.
* Assist in resolving commercial or operational concerns during process implementation.

F. Strategic Growth & Management Reporting

* Develop a structured BPO client acquisition strategy.
* Identify profitable outsourcing service categories and expansion opportunities.
* Maintain a database of potential clients, leads, proposals, and active negotiations.
* Submit regular reports on client outreach, meetings, proposals, and acquisition progress.
* Present business growth opportunities directly to the Founder and Top Management.
* Recommend improvements in pricing, client acquisition, partnerships, and business development strategies.
* Contribute to the long-term revenue growth and sustainability of the company's BPO division.

3. TYPES OF PROCESSES WE ARE LOOKING TO ACQUIRE

The selected candidate should have the ability to source opportunities across the following categories:

**Domestic BPO Processes**

* Inbound Customer Support
* Outbound Customer Support
* Domestic Voice Processes
* Non-Voice Processes
* Email & Chat Support
* E-commerce Customer Support
* Order Management & Customer Assistance
* Back-Office Operations
* Lead Generation & Appointment Setting
* Technical Helpdesk Support

**International BPO Processes**

* International Voice Processes
* US / UK / Australian Customer Support
* International Chat & Email Support
* Technical Support
* International Back-Office Operations
* E-commerce Support
* Customer Experience Management
* SaaS Customer Support

The company will prioritize legitimate processes with clearly defined commercial terms, operational requirements, and sustainable revenue potential.

4. REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, or a related discipline preferred.
* Relevant experience in BPO process acquisition, outsourcing sales, international business development, or client acquisition.
* Strong understanding of domestic and international BPO operations.
* Existing professional connections with direct clients, outsourcing decision-makers, or procurement teams will be a significant advantage.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and business presentation skills.
* Ability to independently identify and close outsourcing opportunities.
* Understanding of BPO pricing, SLAs, contracts, and client onboarding procedures.
* Experience using LinkedIn, CRM tools, email outreach, and professional networking platforms.
* Strong analytical, commercial, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate with senior leadership.

5. PREFERRED CANDIDATE PROFILE

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

* Have previously acquired BPO processes for an outsourcing company.
* Have an established network of genuine direct clients.
* Understand the complete BPO process acquisition lifecycle.
* Can independently manage client discussions from lead generation to commercial closure.
* Have experience acquiring processes for small or growing BPO operations.
* Can provide a practical roadmap for securing the company's first outsourcing project.
* Are comfortable working in a growing organization and contributing to the development of a new business division.

**Candidates with proven BPO process acquisition experience and direct client relationships will receive preference.**

6. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated on:

* Number of genuine outsourcing leads generated.
* Number of qualified direct-client connections established.
* Client meetings scheduled and completed.
* Proposals submitted and negotiations progressed.
* Number of commercially viable processes acquired.
* Revenue potential and profitability of acquired projects.
* Successful process onboarding and launch.
* Client relationship quality and retention.
* Accuracy of reporting and pipeline management.
* Overall contribution to the company's BPO business expansion.

Targets will be established according to the company's operational readiness, available resources, and business priorities.

7. AUTHORITY & REPORTING STRUCTURE

The selected candidate will be authorized to:

* Communicate with prospective outsourcing clients.
* Conduct business development and client acquisition activities.
* Schedule and attend client meetings.
* Present company-approved business proposals.
* Discuss outsourcing requirements and proposed commercial models.
* Coordinate with internal teams regarding process feasibility.
* Recommend potential clients and outsourcing agreements for management approval.

**Important:** Final authority regarding contract execution, pricing approval, financial commitments, process acceptance, and strategic partnerships will remain with the Founder or authorized Top Management.

The candidate will not be permitted to make binding commitments or sign agreements on behalf of the company without written authorization.

8. WHAT WE OFFER

* Opportunity to build and expand a new BPO business division.
* Direct interaction with the Founder and Top Management.
* Exposure to domestic and international outsourcing markets.
* Opportunity to develop long-term strategic client relationships.
* Performance-linked incentives and professional growth opportunities.
* Scope for advancement into senior business development or BPO leadership positions based on demonstrated performance.

9. HOW TO APPLY

Interested candidates with relevant experience in **BPO Process Acquisition, Outsourcing Business Development, Direct Client Acquisition, or International BPO Sales** are invited to apply.

Applicants should share:

* Updated CV / Resume
* LinkedIn Profile
* Total Relevant Experience
* Types of BPO Processes Previously Acquired
* Domestic / International Client Acquisition Experience
* Notice Period
* Current and Expected Compensation

**Company:** Edvirexa Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

**Join Edvirexa Technologies Pvt. Ltd. and play a key role in building our domestic and international BPO outsourcing division.**

We are looking for a professional who can do more than generate leads — **we need someone capable of bringing genuine outsourcing business, building direct client relationships, and converting opportunities into operational BPO projects.**

**Regards,**  
**Talent Acquisition & Top Management**  
**Edvirexa Technologies Pvt. Ltd.**

description:
**Company Overview**

**﻿**

Cellebrite’s (NASDAQ: CLBT) mission is to enable its customers to protect and save lives, accelerate justice, and preserve privacy in communities around the world. We are a global leader in Digital Intelligence solutions for the public and private sectors, empowering organizations in mastering the complexities of legally sanctioned digital investigations by streamlining intelligence processes. Trusted by thousands of leading agencies and companies worldwide, Cellebrite’s Digital Intelligence platform and solutions transform how customers collect, review, analyze and manage data in legally sanctioned investigations.

  
  
  

**Position Overview**

As a Sales Manager, you’ll be at the forefront of cutting-edge technology, helping law enforcement and enterprises unlock critical digital intelligence. Thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment where your contributions directly impact public safety and corporate security. Engage with diverse clients, drive meaningful change, and enjoy a blend of challenge and reward.

We seek a dynamic, driven individual passionate about driving new business. The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication and problem-solving skills, strong organizational abilities, and a high level of energy. Resilience and the ability to handle prospecting activities are crucial.

**Your responsibilities:**

  

* Identify and pursue net new sales opportunities through cold-calling, market outreach & campaigns in public sector/ LEA’s.
* Conduct presentations to potential clients in India/ neighboring non-sales banned countries.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers.
* Collaborate with internal teams to create tailored solutions that meet client needs.
* Prepare and deliver sales proposals and contracts.
* Track and report on sales performance metrics and market trends.
* Establish relationships and engage at executive levels within assigned public sector accounts to identify and sell Cellebrite Solutions.
* Provides professional leadership, coordination and directions to the team as and when required/ delegated.
* Build up strategic contacts at CIO, managing director and executive level
* Carry a revenue quota to meet or exceed sales targets and demonstrate continuous progress towards achieving account strategies.
* Draw up and implement analysis of key accounts, using CRM and related analysis tools
* Identify, develop, execute, and maintain account strategies to drive adoption of Cellebrite solution sand services revenue within assigned accounts and their affiliates.
* Establish and lead teams of internal and external resources to identify, pursue, and close specific opportunities consistent with account strategies.
* Take on responsibility for overall project management – from acquisition of new projects to coordination of project participants.
* Establish and maintain close relationships with marketing, solution engineers, consultants, and sales operations to access to and leverage from appropriate internal resources.
* stablish and maintain relationships with resellers, system integrators, and any other external partner to develop and achieve account strategies and opportunity plans.
* Understand and navigate account procurement practices to successfully negotiate profitable licensing contracts.
* Drive prompt resolution of customer issues and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction with Cellebrite products and services.
* Serve as the primary client contact for non-technical or support issues requiring escalation.
* Provide regular and efficient updates on assigned accounts to sales management.
* Ensure accurate and timely forecasts in CRM.
* Should have a strong Hunting Experience
* Participate in industry events and conferences to promote Cellebrite’s offerings.
* Provide feedback to product development teams based on customer insights and market demands.

**Requierments:**

* 10+ years of experience in government or public sector sales, preferably in the solution selling, digital intelligence field.
* Coming from technology or leading software companies in simar domain.
* Strong understanding of sales, procurement processes, partnerships led projects & delivery.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including senior management levels.
* Ability to develop, foster and maintain client relationships.
* Able to work in a hybrid mode in Cellebrite's Noida office.
* Travel frequently to clients’ locations to craft large deals from scratch.
* Should be able to demonstrate a problem-solving mindset basis experience in the related field.
* Viewed as an expert in software or solutioning subscription sales in the industry.
* Track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas
* Experience working with external partners to develop and close business within assigned accounts.
* Experience in negotiating complex licensing agreements.
* Network of agencies “reference contacts” with whom one has built a trust relationship and with
* whom one can gain an audience to present Cellebrite solutions and identify opportunities.
* Ability to travel as appropriate in order to manage and close opportunities within assigned accounts and their subsidiaries and affiliates.
* Work with minimal supervision.
* Person must be flexible and able to deal with fast and rapid change.

A B O U T K O F F E L O

Koffelo is a premium Indian coffee brand. We make coffee for people who are always on the move, and our gift, hampers bring the same care to the people who buy gifts for others. Hotels that want to welcome guests well, hospitals that want to thank their teams, hostels, corporates, and the agencies that plan gifting for them all come to us when they need quality at volume. We are looking for someone who enjoys a good conversation, likes closing a deal, and does not give up on a lead just because it went quiet for a week.

A B O U T T H E R O L E

Mostly desk-based, with some travel. This is a full-time role based at our Sector 134 office in Noida. Most of the work happens from the desk: research, calls, WhatsApp and email follow-ups, quotes, and video or phone meetings. Some of it happens out in the field. You will travel to meet clients when a meeting is best held in person, such as a tasting, a site visit, or a walkthrough of a hamper for a decision-maker. Travel is occasional, not daily, and it is planned around your accounts. It suits people who are comfortable going out and handling a day or two on the road when needed. If you prefer to build your business mainly from the office, you will still have a full pipeline to work, and we will be clear about travel expectations before you join.

**2 to 4 years in B2B, field, or corporate sales. FMCG, gifting, hospitality, or food and**

**beverage is a plus. Strong recent sales results or a clear track record of winning repeat business.**

**W H A T Y O U W I L L D O**

Help businesses give something worth remembering, one hamper order at a time.

Find the right clients. Research hotels, hostels, hospitals, clinics, corporates, schools, and gifting agencies in and

around Noida and Delhi NCR. Keep your lists clean in Excel or Google Sheets.

Start the conversation. Reach out by call, WhatsApp, or email, and set up meetings with the people who actually

make gifting decisions: admin heads, HR, procurement, and owners.

Meet clients in person when it counts. Run tastings and hamper walkthroughs, and plan your visits so you cover

the accounts that matter most.

Work with agencies. Build relationships with corporate gifting companies and event planners who buy hampers for their own clients. A good agency can bring you a steady stream of orders.

Follow up, every time. Keep a simple rhythm for every lead: call, message, revisit. Log each step so nothing slips and no good prospect goes cold.

Close and look after the order. Prepare quotes for different quantities, customise hampers where needed, and work with operations on dispatch and delivery timelines.

Report and share what you hear. Send a short weekly update to the Sales Head on calls, meetings, quotes, and orders, and pass on what clients are asking for and what they are paying.

**Company:** Techlance Global Pvt. Ltd.

**Salary:** 10000/- to 50000/- INR per month

**About the Role**

Techlance Global Pvt. Ltd. is looking for enthusiastic, ambitious, and result-oriented individuals to join our sales team as IT Sales Executives.

In this role, you will be responsible for promoting MUN-C business management software and Techlance Global's IT and software development services to businesses across different industries.

This opportunity is suitable for fresh graduates who want to build a career in IT sales, as well as candidates with 1–2 years of sales or business development experience.

**Please note: This is an active sales role that requires self-generated lead generation, direct customer interaction, field visits, and deal closure.** Candidates should be comfortable approaching new businesses, making cold calls, scheduling meetings, visiting prospective clients, presenting software solutions, negotiating with customers, and following up until a deal is closed.

You will not be limited to working on leads provided by the company. You will be expected to identify potential customers independently, build your own sales pipeline, and take ownership of your sales activities and results.

**What You Will Sell**

You will represent MUN-C and Techlance Global's software products and technology services, including:

* **School Management Software** – Solutions for schools and educational institutions.
* **HR Management Software (HRMS)** – Employee management and HR process automation.
* **Lead and Sales Management Software** – Tools to organize leads, follow-ups, and sales activities.
* **Inventory and Warehouse Management Software** – Solutions for stock control and warehouse operations.
* **POS Software** – Billing and sales solutions for retail businesses and restaurants.
* **Business Management Solutions** – Software to streamline business operations and workflows.
* **E-commerce and Quick Commerce Development** – Online shopping platforms and rapid-commerce solutions.
* **Website, Web Application and Mobile Application Development** – Custom technology solutions for businesses.
* **Other Custom Software Development Services** – Applications and digital solutions based on client requirements.

You will learn about these solutions and identify which products or services are most relevant to each prospective customer.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Self-Generated Lead Generation**

* Identify potential customers through market research, LinkedIn, cold calling, networking, referrals, business directories, and field visits.
* Research businesses that may benefit from software solutions offered by MUN-C and Techlance Global.
* Build and maintain your own database of prospective clients.
* Contact business owners, school administrators, HR managers, restaurant owners, retailers, warehouse managers, and other decision-makers.
* Initiate conversations with new prospects and identify opportunities to introduce our products and services.
* Generate qualified leads independently instead of relying solely on company-provided enquiries.

**2. Field Sales and Direct Client Visits**

* Visit prospective businesses and meet decision-makers in person.
* Identify potential customers in assigned markets and business segments.
* Introduce MUN-C products and Techlance Global's software development services during face-to-face meetings.
* Explain how the relevant software can address customers' operational challenges.
* Schedule follow-up meetings and product demonstrations.
* Maintain regular contact with prospects until the opportunity progresses toward a sale.
* Travel locally for customer meetings and business development activities as required.

**Candidates must be willing to conduct field visits and meet prospective customers in person. Field sales is an essential part of this position.**

**3. Cold Calling and Customer Outreach**

* Make outbound calls to prospective customers.
* Introduce the company, understand customer requirements, and explain relevant solutions.
* Follow up through telephone calls, email, LinkedIn, and other professional communication channels.
* Handle initial objections and identify genuine business opportunities.
* Schedule meetings and product demonstrations with interested prospects.

**4. Product Presentation and Sales**

* Learn the features, benefits, and use cases of MUN-C's software solutions.
* Understand the customer's business challenges and recommend suitable products or services.
* Present software solutions in simple, business-focused language.
* Coordinate with internal teams for product demonstrations and technical clarifications.
* Share proposals and quotations as per company guidelines.
* Follow up with prospects, address concerns, and help move opportunities toward closure.

**5. Negotiation and Deal Closure**

* Maintain ownership of opportunities from initial contact through follow-up and closure.
* Understand customer requirements, budgets, timelines, and decision-making processes.
* Communicate pricing and commercial terms accurately.
* Coordinate with the management team when approvals or technical inputs are required.
* Convert qualified prospects into paying customers.
* Maintain professional relationships to encourage repeat business and referrals.

**6. Sales Reporting and Performance**

* Maintain daily records of calls, leads, meetings, field visits, and follow-ups.
* Update the designated CRM or sales tracking system.
* Work toward agreed lead generation, meeting, pipeline, and revenue targets.
* Report progress, customer feedback, and market opportunities to the reporting manager.
* Continuously improve sales performance through feedback, product learning, and customer interactions.

**Who Should Apply?**

We welcome applications from:

* Fresh graduates interested in building a career in IT sales and business development.
* Candidates with 1–2 years of experience in sales, business development, field sales, or customer acquisition.
* Candidates interested in selling software products, SaaS solutions, ERP, CRM, HRMS, POS, or IT services.
* Individuals who are comfortable with cold calling, approaching new customers, and conducting field visits.
* Candidates who are confident communicators, proactive learners, and motivated by achieving sales targets.

Prior IT or software sales experience is an advantage but is not mandatory for candidates who demonstrate strong communication skills, a willingness to learn, and a genuine interest in sales.

**Required Skills**

* Good verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Confidence in speaking with new people and business decision-makers.
* Willingness to make cold calls and generate leads independently.
* Willingness to travel locally and conduct face-to-face client meetings.
* Basic understanding of business operations and an interest in technology.
* Persistence in follow-ups, objection handling, and deal closure.
* Good organizational skills and accountability for assigned targets.
* A positive attitude, willingness to learn, and a results-oriented mindset.

**What You Should Know Before Applying**

* This is a full-time, permanent, work-from-office position in Noida, Sector 62.
* The role includes both office-based sales activities and field sales.
* You will be responsible for generating your own leads and developing new business opportunities.
* You may need to visit prospective customers to present solutions, build relationships, and close deals.
* The role involves working toward defined sales and business development targets.
* Product training and guidance will help you understand our solutions and sales process.

**Candidates who are looking exclusively for desk-based sales, inbound lead handling, remote work, or non-target-based roles may not find this position suitable.**

**Why Join Techlance Global?**

* Start or grow your career in IT and software sales.
* Learn to sell business management software and custom technology solutions.
* Gain hands-on experience in lead generation, field sales, client meetings, negotiations, and deal closure.
* Develop professional relationships with businesses across multiple industries.
* Build practical business development and consultative selling skills.

**How to Apply**

If you are confident, proactive, comfortable meeting new people, and willing to work in both office-based and field sales environments, we encourage you to apply.

Join Techlance Global Pvt. Ltd. and help businesses discover how MUN-C and our software solutions can improve their operations.

**Apply now and take the first step toward building your career in IT sales and business development.**

Job Description: FMCG Store Manager

**Job Title:** FMCG Store Manager / Retail Store Manager  
**Department:** Retail Operations  
**Industry:** FMCG (Fast-Moving Consumer Goods)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Noida / Greater Noida  
**Reports To:** Operations Manager / Business Owner

Job Summary

We are looking for a responsible and experienced FMCG Store Manager to manage daily store operations, inventory, product availability, sales, customer service, and staff performance. The ideal candidate should have knowledge of FMCG products, inventory management, stock replenishment, billing systems, vendor coordination, and retail store operations.

The candidate will ensure smooth store functioning, minimize stock losses, maintain product quality, and deliver an excellent customer experience while achieving sales and profitability targets.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Store Operations**

* Manage day-to-day store activities and ensure smooth operations.
* Maintain store cleanliness, product displays, shelves, and product availability.
* Ensure proper opening and closing procedures.
* Follow company policies, operational procedures, and store standards.

**2. Inventory and Stock Management**

* Monitor stock levels and maintain optimum inventory.
* Manage stock receiving, verification, storage, and replenishment.
* Conduct regular physical stock counts and reconcile inventory discrepancies.
* Monitor expiry dates, damaged goods, and near-expiry products using FIFO/FEFO practices.
* Reduce stock shortages, wastage, pilferage, and inventory losses.

**3. FMCG Product and Vendor Management**

* Handle FMCG categories such as packaged foods, snacks, beverages, dairy products, personal care, and household essentials.
* Coordinate with distributors, wholesalers, and manufacturers for timely deliveries.
* Verify purchase invoices, quantities, product prices, and batch details.
* Maintain records of purchases, returns, schemes, and vendor payments as applicable.

**4. Sales and Customer Service**

* Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
* Monitor fast-moving and slow-moving products.
* Ensure correct pricing, barcode scanning, promotions, and product placement.
* Handle customer complaints and resolve issues professionally.
* Recommend products and promotional offers to improve sales.

**5. Billing and Cash Management**

* Supervise POS billing, cash handling, UPI, and digital payments.
* Ensure accurate billing and daily cash reconciliation.
* Monitor discounts, refunds, returns, and billing discrepancies.
* Prepare daily sales and collection reports.

**6. Staff Management**

* Allocate duties and prepare staff schedules.
* Train employees in customer service, billing, stock handling, and store procedures.
* Monitor staff attendance, discipline, and productivity.
* Ensure adequate staffing during peak business hours.

**7. Reporting and Performance Monitoring**

* Prepare daily sales, stock, wastage, and expense reports.
* Track sales, gross margins, inventory turnover, and stock availability.
* Maintain purchase orders, invoices, stock registers, and other store records.
* Suggest improvements in product assortment, purchasing, and store profitability.

**8. Compliance and Safety**

* Follow applicable FSSAI requirements for food products and other relevant regulations.
* Maintain proper storage conditions and food hygiene.
* Ensure safe handling of goods and compliance with fire and workplace safety procedures.

Required Qualifications and Skills

* Graduate or equivalent qualification; a degree or diploma in Retail Management, Business Administration, or Commerce is preferred.
* 2–5 years of experience in FMCG retail, supermarket, grocery, or convenience-store operations.
* Knowledge of FMCG brands, product categories, distributors, and retail pricing.
* Experience with POS billing, inventory software, MS Excel, and stock reporting.
* Strong communication, leadership, problem-solving, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage stock, staff, sales targets, and multiple operational tasks.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Monthly sales growth.
* Gross profit margin.
* Inventory accuracy and stock availability.
* Expiry, damage, and wastage percentage.
* Reduction in stock loss and pilferage.
* Customer satisfaction and complaint resolution.
* Billing accuracy and cash reconciliation.
* Vendor delivery performance.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with experience at supermarkets, grocery chains, FMCG distributors, convenience stores, or organised retail businesses will be preferred. Experience in multi-store operations or franchise-based retail management is an added advantage.

**How to Apply:** Interested candidates may share their updated resume, relevant work experience, current salary, expected salary, and notice period.

Job Description: Business Development Manager (FMCG & Retail Franchise)

**Job Title:** Business Development Manager  
**Department:** Business Development & Franchise Expansion  
**Industry:** FMCG, Retail & Convenience Stores  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Noida / Greater Noida  
**Reports To:** Founder / Director / Business Head

1. Job Summary

We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Business Development Manager to drive business growth, franchise expansion, strategic partnerships, and revenue generation for My Store 24/7.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, acquiring franchise partners, developing relationships with FMCG brands and distributors, negotiating commercial agreements, and expanding the company's network of convenience stores operating through fixed and movable-container formats.

The ideal candidate should have strong sales, negotiation, networking, communication, and business planning skills, with experience in FMCG, retail, franchising, or organised retail operations.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Business Development & Expansion

* Identify and develop new business opportunities in FMCG, grocery retail, and convenience-store markets.
* Develop strategies to expand My Store 24/7 across Noida, Greater Noida, Delhi NCR, and other target locations.
* Research market trends, competitor activities, customer demand, and potential growth areas.
* Identify suitable commercial locations, container-store placement opportunities, and business partnerships.
* Build a pipeline of prospective franchise partners, investors, and business associates.

B. Franchise Sales & Partner Acquisition

* Generate franchise leads through networking, digital platforms, referrals, and direct outreach.
* Present the My Store 24/7 franchise business model, investment structure, operational requirements, and commercial opportunity to prospects.
* Conduct meetings, presentations, and follow-ups with potential franchise owners.
* Negotiate franchise terms and coordinate the onboarding process.
* Maintain a database of leads, conversion rates, franchise enquiries, and partner relationships.
* Coordinate with internal teams to support franchise launch and initial operations.

C. FMCG Brand & Supplier Partnerships

* Establish relationships with FMCG manufacturers, distributors, wholesalers, and regional suppliers.
* Explore partnerships with established packaged-food, snack, beverage, personal-care, and household-product brands.
* Negotiate product pricing, distributor margins, credit terms, promotional schemes, and supply arrangements.
* Identify opportunities for bulk purchasing and centralised procurement to improve profitability.
* Develop long-term supplier relationships to ensure reliable product availability and competitive pricing.

D. Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth

* Develop and execute business development plans to achieve monthly and annual growth targets.
* Identify new revenue streams, strategic alliances, and cross-selling opportunities.
* Prepare sales forecasts, business proposals, and expansion plans.
* Monitor franchise acquisition costs, conversion rates, revenue growth, and business profitability.
* Recommend pricing, promotional, and partnership strategies to improve commercial performance.

E. Market Research & Competitor Analysis

* Analyse competitors in the convenience-store, grocery, supermarket, and franchise sectors.
* Study customer preferences, product demand, pricing strategies, and emerging retail trends.
* Identify potential markets for movable-container convenience stores.
* Prepare market research reports and recommend suitable locations for expansion.
* Track competitor franchise models and identify opportunities to differentiate My Store 24/7.

F. Relationship Management

* Build and maintain strong relationships with franchisees, suppliers, landlords, corporate clients, and strategic partners.
* Conduct regular follow-ups to maintain partner satisfaction and identify additional opportunities.
* Coordinate with operations, procurement, marketing, and finance teams.
* Resolve business-related issues and support long-term partner retention.

G. Reporting & Performance Monitoring

* Maintain records of leads, meetings, proposals, negotiations, and signed agreements.
* Prepare weekly and monthly business development reports.
* Track KPIs, including qualified leads, franchise conversions, new partnerships, sales growth, and revenue generation.
* Present expansion progress and business performance reports to management.
* Use CRM software, spreadsheets, and reporting tools to manage the sales pipeline.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Commerce, or a related field.
* 3–6 years of experience in business development, B2B sales, franchise sales, FMCG, or retail expansion.
* Experience in franchise acquisition, channel development, distributor management, or strategic partnerships is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of sales pipelines, lead generation, negotiation, and commercial proposal preparation.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, CRM software, and business reporting.
* Excellent communication, presentation, networking, and relationship-management skills.
* Ability to travel for business meetings, market visits, and partner acquisition when required.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of qualified franchise leads generated.
* Number of franchise agreements signed.
* Franchise lead-to-conversion ratio.
* Number of new supplier and brand partnerships established.
* Revenue generated through new business opportunities.
* Expansion into new locations and markets.
* Value of commercial agreements negotiated.
* Cost per franchise acquisition.
* Achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual business targets.

5. Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be proactive, commercially minded, target-driven, and comfortable building a business from the ground up. Candidates with experience in FMCG companies, organised retail chains, convenience stores, supermarket franchises, distributor networks, or franchise consulting will be preferred.

Experience with emerging retail formats, mobile retail units, or container-based businesses will be an added advantage.

6. Compensation & Incentives

* Competitive salary based on experience and skills.
* Performance-based incentives linked to measurable business development targets.
* Additional rewards for successful franchise acquisition and strategic partnerships, subject to company policy.
* Travel reimbursement for approved business visits.

7. How to Apply

Interested candidates may share their updated resume along with relevant experience, current salary, expected salary, notice period, and details of their previous business development achievements.

title: Sales Manager
description:
About Pixl Agents

Most businesses lose customers in the gap between an enquiry and a reply. The WhatsApp message nobody answered at 11pm. The Instagram DM that sat for two days. The lead who went quiet because nobody followed up.

Pixl Agents fixes that. Businesses build their own AI agents that answer customers on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and email, qualify leads, book appointments and run follow-ups. The agents answer from the business’s own prices, policies and FAQs. AI phone calling in English, Hindi and other Indian languages is in early access. Maya, our AI assistant, ties it all together: owners ask her what’s working, and she builds agents and prepares campaigns. When a chat needs a person, the business’s own team takes over.

We work with clinics, real estate teams, education and coaching institutes, online stores and service businesses across India. We’re early (founded 2024), growing fast, and building the team that will put an AI agent in every business that still answers enquiries by hand.

The role

You’ll bring business owners onto Pixl. You’ll find them, show them how many enquiries they’re losing, and get their first AI agent live. Pick the setup that fits you:

* Run **free business audits** with owners and turn them into pilots and paid plans.
* Sell our **14-day pilot** (₹9,999 + GST). It’s backed by a guarantee: 95% of new enquiries answered within 60 seconds, or the pilot fee comes back.
* Close businesses onto monthly plans, from small teams up to our Agency plan.
* Get customers live: connect their WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger, and load their prices, FAQs and timings.
* Visit clinics, property offices and institutes in person where that’s what closes the deal (full-time).
* Tell the product team what you’re hearing: why owners buy, why they hesitate, what they ask for.

Who we’re looking for

**What everyone needs:**

What you get

JOB DESCRIPTIONTele Sales Executive – Business Loans

**Company:** CredFlow  
**Job Title:** Tele Sales Executive  
**Department:** Sales  
**Location:** Noida, Uttar Pradesh  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Industry:** FinTech / BFSI / Business Lending

About CredFlow

CredFlow is an innovative FinTech company focused on simplifying and streamlining credit management for businesses. The company provides technology-driven solutions that help businesses optimize cash flow, manage receivables, and improve credit management.

At CredFlow, we aim to empower businesses with accessible financial solutions and support their growth through technology-enabled lending and financial services.

About the Role

We are looking for a dynamic, confident, and result-oriented **Tele Sales Executive** to join our Sales team in Noida. The selected candidate will be responsible for connecting with potential customers through company-provided leads, understanding their financial requirements, explaining business loan products, and converting interested prospects into qualified business loan applications.

This role requires excellent communication skills, a persuasive approach, strong follow-up abilities, and the motivation to achieve sales targets in a fast-paced FinTech environment.

The ideal candidate should have experience in telesales, telecalling, business loans, banking, financial services, or the BFSI industry.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Outbound Calling and Lead Engagement**

* Make outbound calls to prospective customers using leads provided by the company.
* Connect with business owners, entrepreneurs, and potential borrowers to understand their financial requirements.
* Introduce CredFlow's business loan offerings and generate interest among potential customers.
* Conduct effective conversations to identify genuine and interested prospects.
* Maintain a professional and customer-friendly approach during every interaction.

**2. Business Loan Product Explanation**

* Explain the features, benefits, eligibility criteria, and application process of business loan products.
* Understand the customer's business requirements and assess their initial suitability for the loan.
* Provide accurate information about loan-related requirements, documentation, and next steps.
* Address customer queries and communicate product details clearly and confidently.
* Ensure customers understand the process without making unverified promises regarding loan approval, interest rates, or disbursement.

**3. Lead Qualification and Conversion**

* Qualify leads based on defined eligibility criteria and internal sales guidelines.
* Understand basic customer details, business information, funding requirements, and loan purpose.
* Identify interested and eligible prospects for further processing.
* Guide customers through the initial application process and coordinate the collection of required information.
* Convert qualified leads into completed business loan applications and contribute to overall business targets.

**4. Follow-Ups and Objection Handling**

* Follow up with interested prospects to move them forward in the loan application process.
* Handle customer objections related to loan eligibility, documentation, interest rates, and application procedures.
* Re-engage customers who have shown interest but have not completed their applications.
* Maintain consistent communication with prospects until the lead is converted, closed, or marked inactive.
* Build trust with potential customers through timely responses and professional communication.

**5. Sales Targets and Performance Management**

* Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly calling, lead qualification, and conversion targets.
* Maintain productivity standards and ensure effective utilization of company-provided leads.
* Track lead status, follow-up schedules, and conversion progress.
* Work towards improving call quality, customer engagement, and application conversion rates.
* Participate in regular performance reviews, sales meetings, and coaching sessions.

**6. CRM Management and Reporting**

* Maintain accurate and updated records of calls, customer interactions, lead status, and follow-ups in the CRM system.
* Record relevant customer information and feedback after every interaction.
* Prepare daily sales reports and share progress updates with the reporting manager.
* Ensure proper tracking of leads throughout the sales funnel.
* Follow company policies regarding customer information, data confidentiality, and communication practices.

**7. Coordination and Customer Experience**

* Coordinate with internal sales, loan processing, and relevant operational teams to support application progression.
* Ensure a smooth and professional customer experience throughout the initial sales journey.
* Escalate complex customer queries or issues to the appropriate team.
* Follow company policies, sales processes, and applicable customer communication guidelines.

Required Qualifications and Experience

description:
**Department:** Accounts & Finance  
**Experience:** 4–5 Years  
**Qualification:** B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance)/ CA Inter  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** [Noida]

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Accounts & Finance professional with 4–5 years of hands-on experience in accounting, GST compliance, TDS, taxation, banking operations, and financial reporting. The candidate should be capable of independently managing day-to-day accounting activities, statutory compliances, account reconciliations, and preparation of financial reports while ensuring accuracy and timely compliance with applicable regulations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Accounts & Bookkeeping**

* Manage day-to-day accounting transactions, including sales, purchases, receipts, payments, journal entries, and expense bookings.
* Maintain accurate books of accounts and ensure proper ledger scrutiny.
* Perform bank reconciliation, vendor reconciliation, customer reconciliation, and intercompany reconciliation.
* Manage accounts payable (AP), accounts receivable (AR), and employee advances and expense settlements.
* Maintain fixed asset registers and assist with depreciation calculations.
* Ensure proper documentation and accounting records for audit purposes.

**2. GST Compliance**

* Prepare and file GST returns, including GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B.
* Reconcile GSTR-2B with purchase registers to ensure eligible Input Tax Credit (ITC).
* Review GST invoices, HSN/SAC codes, tax rates, and place-of-supply requirements.
* Monitor GST payments, input tax credit claims, and credit/debit notes.
* Coordinate with consultants and authorities for GST notices, assessments, and other compliance matters.
* Assist with GST reconciliations and annual return preparation, including GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C, wherever applicable.

**3. TDS & Income Tax Compliance**

* Calculate and deduct TDS on vendor payments, professional fees, rent, salaries, and other applicable transactions.
* Ensure timely deposit of TDS and filing of quarterly TDS returns.
* Prepare and reconcile TDS workings with the books of accounts and challans.
* Verify TDS certificates, Form 26AS, AIS, and related tax records, wherever applicable.
* Coordinate for issuance of Form 16 and Form 16A.
* Assist in income tax return preparation, tax audit requirements, and responses to tax notices.

**4. Financial Reporting & MIS**

* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.
* Assist in the preparation of Profit & Loss Account, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Statement.
* Prepare monthly MIS reports, expense reports, budget-versus-actual analysis, and variance reports.
* Monitor cash flow, working capital, outstanding receivables, and vendor payables.
* Prepare ageing reports for accounts receivable and accounts payable.
* Provide financial data and analysis to management for decision-making.

**5. Banking & Payment Operations**

* Handle banking transactions, fund transfers, NEFT, RTGS, and IMPS.
* Prepare payment proposals and coordinate with authorised signatories for approvals.
* Monitor bank balances, loan repayments, interest calculations, and bank charges.
* Maintain bank documentation and assist with bank audits and financial requirements.

**6. Audit & Statutory Compliance**

* Coordinate with statutory auditors, internal auditors, tax consultants, and other professionals.
* Prepare audit schedules, ledger details, reconciliations, and supporting documents.
* Assist in finalisation of accounts and preparation of financial statements.
* Ensure timely completion of statutory compliance activities and maintain proper records.

**7. Payroll & Other Responsibilities**

* Assist with monthly payroll accounting and salary-related TDS calculations.
* Coordinate PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, and other applicable payroll compliances.
* Maintain employee advances, reimbursements, and expense records.
* Support management with additional accounting, taxation, and finance-related assignments.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong practical knowledge of accounting principles and statutory compliances.
* Hands-on experience with **Tally Prime / Tally ERP and MS Excel**.
* Good working knowledge of GST, TDS, income tax, and financial reporting.
* Proficiency in Excel functions, PivotTables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, and reconciliation techniques.
* Ability to prepare financial statements, MIS reports, and cash flow workings.
* Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and maintain accuracy.
* Good communication and coordination skills.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Minimum 4–5 years of relevant experience in Accounts & Finance.
* Practical experience in GST returns, TDS calculations and returns, bank reconciliations, and financial reporting.
* Experience in handling audit requirements and statutory compliance deadlines.
* Candidates with experience in a CA firm or a corporate finance department will be preferred.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely filing of GST and TDS returns.
* Accuracy of accounting entries and reconciliations.
* Timely preparation of monthly MIS and financial reports.
* Timely closure of books of accounts.
* Reduction in outstanding reconciliation items.
* Timely completion of vendor payments and customer follow-ups.
* Compliance with statutory deadlines and audit requirements.
